title: Evaporometer
summary: EVAPOROM'ETER, noun [Latin evaporo, and Gr. measure.] An instrument for ascertaining the quantity of a fluid evaporated in a given time; an atmometer.

inlines.v: EVAPOROM'ETER, noun [Latin evaporo, and Gr. measure.] An instrument for ascertaining the quantity of a fluid evaporated in a given time; an atmometer.
